about.title: About Illumineer’s Quest: Deep Trouble
paragraphs: Illumineer’s Quest: Deep Trouble is a Disney Lorcana co-operative boxed game, released on 31 May 2024. Its checklist has the 31 cards numbered 1/31 to 31/31.

The box also has 4 bonus cards numbered in booster sets, so they’re in those sets’ checklists: Piglet - Pooh Pirate Captain (Into the Inklands 223/204), Mulan - Elite Archer (Ursula’s Return 224/204), Yen Sid - Powerful Sorcerer (Ursula’s Return 223/204) and Mickey Mouse - Playful Sorcerer (Ursula’s Return 225/204).
This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
Card details come from LorcanaJSON, card images from Lorcast and prices from TCGplayer.
